blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Tuesday, Nov. 17, said that access to the arrested individuals was delayed because of its “factual” assessments and procedures. The NCRPO issued the statement following Gabriela Women’s Party Rep. Sarah Elago remarks that they were repeatedly denied access to the detainees at Camp Bagong Diwa
